newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Normandy eyes North America presence.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Normandy eyes North America presence.

text.p: Australia's largest gold miner, Normandy Mining Ltd, said on Wednesday was considering a listing in North America to make the company more known there.
Normandy currently has no assets in North America.

"The concept of listing has been current for a while. Now where we list, whether it is Toronto, New York, NASDAQ or anyway else, has yet to be determined," group general manager corporate affairs Colin Jackson told Reuters.
"Just listing and running away isn't going to achieve the outcome that all shareholders would like, so basically somehow some way we will need to have a presence in north America."
The Normandy group produced 1.5 million ounces of gold in the year to June 30, 1996.
Jackson said its level of presence can range from having a corporate relations person there raising the profile to owning assets in North America and through exploration.
"I can't imagine we would be an explorer 100 percent in our own right. I imagine we would be doing it with someone that is more familiar with the ground," he said.
"We would like to be there in some sort of partnership."
Jackson cited the group's La Source joint venture with French government-owned resources and geological survey group, BRMG as an example of the type of venture it would like to form in North America.
Normandy shares closed two cents lower at A$1.78.
